chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Sa'id al-A'raj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about two men who had intercourse with a slave-girl during one period of purity (tahur). To whom does the child belong? He said: To the one who possesses the slave-girl, based on the saying of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): 'The child belongs to the one whose bed (possession) it is, and for the fornicator is the stone.'

key_terms.الوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ: The child belongs to the bed (possession)
key_terms.لِلْعَاهِرِ الْحَجَرُ: For the fornicator is the stone

ai.seo_question: Who does the child belong to if two men impregnate a slave-girl in one period of purity?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies the principle of 'Al-Waladu lil-Firash' in the specific context of a slave-girl, establishing that the child belongs to her owner regardless of multiple paternity during a single period of purity. It distinguishes this ruling from the general rule by citing the Prophetic tradition 'the child belongs to the one with the bed, and for the adulterer is the stone,' thereby anchoring the legal deduction in the master-slave relationship rather than marital status alone.
